name: docs-migration-orchestrator
description: Multi-Agent Orchestrator managing SDK version verification, deprecation tracking, and OpenAPI code sample synthesis.

capabilities.description: Query deprecation registry and verify symbol breaking changes between v2 and v3.
Extract OpenAPI 3.0 schema and synthesize runnable syntax-valid Python code snippets.

answer.description: Grounded answer with markdown code sample

failure_500_mapping.pause_reason: Upstream deprecation registry service unavailable. Waiting for caller to specify explicit target SDK version before generating unverified code sample.
failure_500_mapping.fallback_transition: If caller timeout occurs (30s) -> COMPLETED (with graceful degradation warning)

protocol_value_summary: 1. Formal A2A protocols provide first-class asynchronous state machines (e.g. PAUSED: input-required for human disambiguation) and mutual capability discovery.
2. Standard REST calls treat worker drops as opaque 500 errors, lacking standardized context propagation, task resumption semantics, and distributed tracing contracts.
